definitions.gloss: mattress futon; bottom futon; sleeping mat
definitions.explanation: The futon placed on the floor to sleep on, providing cushioning from the hard floor. Contrasts with {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん} (top covering).

examples.japanese: {敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}を{敷|し}いて{寝|ね}る{準備|じゅんび}をした。
examples.english: I laid out the mattress futon to prepare for bed.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}、{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}を{押|お}し{入|い}れにしまう。
examples.english: In the morning, I put away the mattress futon in the closet.

examples.japanese: この{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}は{厚|あつ}くて{寝心地|ねごこち}がいい。
examples.english: This mattress futon is thick and comfortable to sleep on.

notes:
FORMATION:
{敷|し}き (from {敷|し}く, to spread/lay) + {布団|ぶとん} (futon/bedding)

Literally 'spread-out futon.'

COLLOCATIONS:
・{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}を{敷|し}く - to lay out a mattress futon
・{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}をたたむ - to fold up a mattress futon
・{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}を{干|ほ}す - to air out a mattress futon

CULTURAL NOTE:
In traditional Japanese sleeping, the {敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん} is laid directly on the tatami floor at night and stored in a {押|お}し{入|い}れ (closet) during the day. This allows the room to be used for other purposes.
